POST /platform/v1/campaign-engine/plan.justification: MCR dry-run plan (x-codestra-effects none); fails closed 503 until certified campaign/version/audience readback exists; no durable mutation or provider call

POST /platform/v1/campaign-engine/execut.justification: MCR execute is pinned 403 production_not_authorized before any read, write, reservation, outbox intent or provider call

POST /platform/v1/delivery-events.justification: signed normalized delivery-event ingress (durable_inbox_only) into mcr_delivery_events with monotonic projection onto Middleware-owned exposure/lifecycle state; no provider transport

POST /platform/v1/suppressions.justification: additive idempotent suppression record (durable_record_only) with atomic global lifecycle SUPPRESSED transition; Middleware-owned state only; no provider transport
